releaseNotes: v1.1.0: Bara update — (1) Students aur Teachers mein edit kaam karta hai. (2) Naya Classes tab: har class ki monthly fee, subjects, aur har subject ke mid/final/weekly/monthly marks. (3) Exam banate waqt dates calendar se select ya type kar sakte hain (start date = aaj), exam type aur subjects select hote hain. (4) Marks entry naye flow ke sath: Class → Exam → Student → us ke tamam subjects ek screen pe. (5) Fee tab: naam/roll no se search, class ke hisaab se auto fee, month-by-month arrears aur installments.
